report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV in chronic stage taking Triumeq (abacavir/dolutegravir/lamivudine). Reports low energy, frequent headaches, and fatigue attributed to work stress. Viral load detectable at 340 copies/mL with CD4 count of 410 cells/uL. Misses doses 2-3 times per week and takes drug holidays when feeling well. Has mild side effects (stomach discomfort, headaches) that make adherence challenging. Has basic understanding of undetectable viral load but some confusion on specifics. Expresses concerns about long-term side effects and whether doctors prescribe too readily. Willing to work on improving adherence with structured routine.
